pr_title: Ensure health displays don't pile up transforms when off-screen

issue_context.title: Freezes when editing skins
issue_context.body:
### Type

Performance

### Bug description

Got a really long freeze when editing a skin and scrolling through the selectable skin components

Seems like this happens when sitting and watching auto play a beatmap in the skin editor, then scrolling between the components?

### Screenshots or videos


https://github.com/ppy/osu/assets/66184829/e5b5de70-38f1-4dad-b61e-97d334bfcf8b
